data.one_liner: Access Flutter Android APIs from Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart bindings to Android-specific Flutter APIs such as application context and activity. It is a lightweight plugin that wraps the native Java/Kotlin code.
use_when: Need Android application context in Dart
Need to obtain the Flutter activity from Dart
Working on an Android-only Flutter app
weaknesses: No support for iOS or web
data.setup_notes: Add "jni_flutter" to pubspec dependencies and run flutter pub get. No additional native configuration needed.
